Generators and voice-cloning tools released after the model was trained may not be recognised
Recompression, resizing, screenshots and re-recording change the score

findings.description: CommunityForensics-ViT-S16-384 returns a score between 0 and 1. It is compared with 0.5, the model's own threshold. The score is the model's own output, not a probability that this file is synthetic.
limitations: Trained on: Community Forensics: 4,800+ generators (Park & Owens, CVPR 2025)

Measured locally: ROC AUC 0.997, EER 2.6 % on 500 CommunityForensics-Eval images (GAN fakes only; the authors' own evaluation set); at 0.5, 4.5 % of real images and 8 % of RAISE camera photos were flagged
Generators and voice-cloning tools released after the model was trained may not be recognised
Recompression, resizing, screenshots and re-recording change the score

findings.description: No sharp periodicity in the second derivative along either axis.

statement: Findings are reported at their assertion level: OBSERVATION (measured), INFERENCE (a method's reading with its stated threshold and limitations), CANDIDATE (proposed, not established). Investigator decisions are listed separately and do not alter findings.
